title: They changed the rules of cricket to stop him
description:
England invented Bodyline - fast bowling aimed at the body - just to slow Don Bradman down. It caused a diplomatic crisis, cricket outlawed it, and none of it worked: he retired averaging 99.94. No one else in history has finished above 62.
For Michael Jordan to dominate basketball like that, he'd have needed 43 points a game for his whole career.
